rationale: Instance-level fan-out is restricted to axes a human reviewer can verify in a rendered frame. body_build and life_stage stay in the appearance contract and in every registered entry, but they are pinned to whatever the accepted source asset already carries: a reviewer cannot confirm slim-versus-stocky or adult-versus-senior by looking at frames, so those axes cannot carry a QA gold label.

notes.l9_untouched: The L9 orthogonal array in avengine.appearance.contracts is unchanged. This spec selects which axes a fan-out plan varies; it does not redefine the appearance contract or its four axes.
notes.domain_authority: Axis domains are read from avengine.appearance.contracts (CANONICAL_DOMAINS and COAT_PROFILE_DOMAINS). Adding a breed means adding a contract entry with that breed's reviewed three-level coat domain, never editing this file.
notes.cost_authority: Whether a row needs a new UE asset is derived from the contract's axis-to-operation table, not declared here.
